findings.text: The Process page's whole content escapes its tab panel (layout 1, requirement 1). `process/page.js` `content()` runs `await fetch(...)` and only then calls `div.c(...)`, which breaks the framework's rule "No DOM after an `await`" (doc/rules.md:75, core/View/readme.md:19). So the column lands outside the panel: at 1200 it squeezes the head to about 110px ("Tas" is clipped, one tab left) and runs off the right edge ("launches the sessio", the code block is cut). At 3440 the panel is empty and the content sits at the far right, overlapping the tab bar. Fix: capture the box first, then fill it in the fetch's callback.

The review shots are of the main site, where the page doesn't exist yet: `shots/…-Task-process/1200.png` is "Page Load Error 404" and its layout.json has `errors: 404`. Every visual answer below comes from my own headless render of the worktree's four files over the main site (`%TEMP%/rv-process/b1200.png`, `b3440.png`, `400.png`). After the fix, re-run review.mjs against the worktree.

`core/Task/files.jsonl` exists, but the diff doesn't touch it, so `process/page.js` isn't listed there (requirement 3, "files.jsonl where the folder keeps one"). If a script writes that file, its next run covers this.
At 400 every step row wraps into two lines (state on the first line; session and cost on the second, `400.png`). That is acceptable, but the state then floats on the right with nothing next to it.
